1.name: SERPENT TEMPLE 💀
1.description: Whenever you win a past encounter: Draw 1 card and your opponent discards 1 card from their hand.

2.name: BAZAAR 💀
2.description: At the end of each round, do not draw cards. Whenever you have 1 card or fewer in hand, immediately draw 4 cards.

3.name: FOUNDER'S DAY 💀
3.description: If you ever win 3 successive encounters: You immediately win the game

4.name: GRAND LIBRARY 💀💀
4.description: At the beginning of the game, draw 2 cards from your deck instead of 5. At the end of each round, draw 2 cards instead of 1.

5.name: SCRAPYARD 💀💀
5.description: At the end of each round, draw 2 cards instead of 1. Then place 1 card from your hand under your deck.

6.name: AUCTION HOUSE 💀💀
6.description: Whenever you reveal a card that has less influence than your card in the previous encounter: Discard the top card of your deck.

7.name: HAUNTED CATACOMBS 💀💀💀
7.description: If you reveal a card of the same faction as your card in the previous encounter: You immediately lose the round.

8.name: FOGGY SWAMP 💀💀💀
8.description: Do not reveal your cards in the current encounter after placing them. Instead, reveal and resolve the previous encounter.
